## `src/template.rs`

### struct `Commands`

The `hash → command source` map produced by `preprocess`, carried opaquely to `with_commands`. Callers never inspect it, but `Commands::restore` can rewrite the placeholders in re-serialized YAML back into their `` bash`…` `` source, so a config can round-trip through preprocess → parse → patch → serialize without losing its commands.

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
pub struct Commands(HashMap<String, String>);
```

### struct `Port`

A port field: a literal integer or a preprocessed `datacommand:<hash>` placeholder (originally a `` bash`…` `` command), resolved to a concrete port on deserialize.
